brief: Form sections had no visual separation on the record detail page — a titled section rendered as bold text followed by fields, so a multi-section form read as one flat list. Added a shared FormSectionShell (border + header hairline card, no fill, since --card === --background in both themes) used by BOTH RecordDetailPanel's DetailsTab and FormRenderer; chrome only when sections.length > 1, so a single-section form stays plain. Sections became labelled <section> landmarks (aria-labelledby). Adjacent fixes: DetailsTab's column row was a bare flex that squeezed columns on mobile (now flex-col md:flex-row, matching FormRenderer); FormRenderer's section title/description used hardcoded text-slate-800/text-gray-500 that broke in dark theme (now tokens).
